agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 16, 2023 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS – NONE
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the June 21, 2023, Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2023-08-16 SDWD Item S08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2023-08-16 SDWD Item S08C SDWD Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Quitclaim of Water Easement to Sean Michael Corson, located at 1715 Freda Lane, Cardiff by the Sea, CA 92007 (APN 260-556-06-00). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the District Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" per Section 15378(b)(5) of the CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Olson
1) Adopt Resolution No 2023-10, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of San Dieguito Water District Approving Quitclaim of Water Easement on 1715 Freda Lane, Cardiff by the Sea, (APN 260-556-06-00)"; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Quitclaim Deed of Public Water Easement.
2023-08-16 SDWD Item S08D Quitclaim 1715 Freda Ln
8E.
Authorization to enter into a Professional Services Agreement with Ardurra Group Inc. to provide On-call Professional Consulting Services for various Engineering Task Orders. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board of Directors is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Hariri
Authorize the City Manager, or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney to execute an agreement with Ardurra Group Inc. for professional engineering services in substantial form, in the amount of $200,000 per year for a three-year term, with options to extend upon mutual consent, for two additional one-year terms in an amount not to exceed $200,000 per year for a not to exceed five year term and for a total agreement cost not-to-exceed $1,000,000.
2023-08-16 SDWD Item S08E On-call Professional Consulting Agreement - Ardurra
8F.
Authorization to enter into a Professional Services Agreement with Raftelis Financial Consultants, Inc. to perform a District Water Rate Cost of Service Study. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board of Directors is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378 (b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Authorize the General Manager in consultation with the District Counsel, to execute an agreement with Raftelis Financial Consultants, Inc. in substantial form, in the amount of $98,797, plus a 10 percent contingency of $9,880 for a total cost of $108,677, to conduct the District's Water Rate Cost of Service Study; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2023-12 titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2023-24 Budget" to approve additional appropriations of $8,677 from Capital Fund 532 to bring total project appropriations to $108,677.
2023-08-16 SDWD Item S08F Water Rate Study Agreement Approval
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS – NONE
To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
To speak on informational items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
11A.
Encinitas Valve Replacement Project progress report. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Hariri
Receive the Oral Report.
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON SEPTEMBER 20, 2023
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
